en:
<CLT=cltMIND>There are various art and carving tools...
Makes sense for the <CLT=cltSTRONG>Ultimate Artist<CLT=cltMIND>'s lab.
But why does this lab have locks...?

Atua has spoken... He says this classroom
was probably made for me.
What does that mean?

I will answer that!
With my sexy, beautiful voice!

Wait a second! We said I was gonna answer
that question!

No, we didn't. Is your memory getting even
worse, Monotaro?

You promised! Cuz I don't remember you
not promising!
That doesn't make any sense!

So what!? Just lemme do it!
If you don't...

I'll stick my hand up my butt, then shove it 
in your mouth and rattle your molars around!
Kyaaaa! That's unsanitary!

Oh! W-Wait, Monodam!
We...weren't fighting!

We were just messing around.
Y'know, cuz we're friends...

IT'S-FINE...AS-LONG-AS-YOU'RE-GETTING-
ALONG.
So, what's up with the key?

Oh, yes... Angie's the kinda girl who can't focus
on her art unless she's alone.

I must shut out all people and noises so that
I can be one with the great Atua.

Nyahahaha! Atua is much too shy to be one
with me in front of people!
Wow! Like a pornstar!
How!? It's the opposite!

So any room where I'm gonna make art needs
to have a key, but...
I'm surprised the Monokubs knew that.

And these are all my favorite art supplies
and sculpting tools, too...
How did you know?

U-Ummm... What should I say?
I'm...not a good improviser.
C-Calm down...I'm even worse.

WE-KNOW...EVERYTHING-ABOUT-YOU-
BASTARDS.
BECAUSE-WE-WANT-TO-BE-YOUR-FRIENDS.
I don't wanna be friends with you.

I'm only interested in Monokuma. I don't wanna
get friendly with knock-off products.

WHY...WOULD-YOU-SAY-THAT?
WHY...DO-YOU-HATE-ME?

I-WON'T-FORGIVE-ANYONE-WHO-REFUSES-
TO-GET-ALONG-WITH-ME!

N-Now now, Monodam... We haven't given
them the key to this room, have we?

Okayyyy, here it is. But there's only one key,
so don't lose it.

It'd be bad if you lost it. You wouldn't be able
to lock the door or open it from the outside.
LET-ME-SEE-THAT-KEY.

<CLT=cltMIND>Monodam swiped the key from Monophanie,
then lifted it to his mouth...
...NOM.
Ah! He ate it!
...GULP.
Ah! He swallowed it!
BEEP...BEEP...BEEEEEEEEEEP...
Ah! He's flatlining!

What are you doing? If you swallow that key,
you'll definitely choke on it.

SOMEONE-MIGHT-USE-THIS-KEY...FOR-
MURDER.
BECAUSE-KEYS...ARE-MYSTERIOUS.

IF-SOMETHING-BAD-HAPPENS, IT-WOULD-
BE-TOO-LATE...
I-WANT...EVERYONE-TO-GET-ALONG.
Oh, Monodam...you're so reckless.
Let's carry Monodam away for now.

We'll carry him like a kind boss taking care
of a drunk employee.

So does that mean we can't get the key?
What the hell...?

But I'm only gonna lock this door when I'm
inside working, so...

I don't care if I can't open or close the door
from the outside.
Oh, I guess that's fine then...

By the way, those guys said they know
everything about us, right?

That's probably why this lab fits Angie's
tastes so well...

So does that mean...this school was specially
made for us?

Monokuma has claimed that before...
but is that really possible?

This giant complex was built just 
for the sixteen of us?

It's a miraculous mystery that only Atua knows.
But it doesn't matter.
As long as it's comfortable, I'm fine.

If our lives here become more enriched, then
there's even less reason to leave this place.
Ah-haha, that's truuue.
<CLT=cltMIND>Are we supposed to be okay with that...?

Ooh...look, Shuichi.
The ceiling here is pretty unique.
Ah, yeah...exposed beams.
I wonder...

Is it supposed to be like this? Or did they
just not finish it in time?

Those cheap knock-offs are useless.
Like that time they mixed up the Kubs Pads.

I don't care. This kinda bare ceiling doesn't
bother me.

Even Atua says it's more sensitive when
the skin's peeled back.

Yeah, I don't care either. If it makes life here
more interesting, then I'm fine with that.
<CLT=cltMIND>Should we be fine with that?

I see, I see... There's an easel, brushes, and
all kinds of art supplies here.

Sculpting tools, chisels, and a wooden hammer!
What a divine collection of tools!

These are all my favorites, so I can make do
even if I don't have access to DeepSea.

Now that you mention it...
I don't see any completed pieces in here.

I would expect an art room to have sculptures
and replica paintings and things like that...

I don't need references when Atua is the
one who creates the art.

From now on, this place will be filled with
my collaborations with Atua!

If our lives here become more enriched, then
there's even less reason to leave this place.
<CLT=cltMIND>I'll investigate around here a little more.
Yes
No
Are you unsure of something?
<CLT=cltSYSTEM>Would you like to leave?

<CLT=cltMIND>It's a monitor for communicating with us.
There's nothing on the screen.
<CLT=cltMIND>But just seeing it makes me feel sick...

<CLT=cltMIND>What is this heap of stuff?
It doesn't look like wood or stone...
Ohhh, this is wax for making wax sculptures.

Ah, wax sculptures, huh?
You can make those, Angie?

Unlike wood or stone, wax has a soft texture
for sculpting.

Oh, but Atua is the one who's gonna be doing
the sculpting.
Ah, I see.

But, but it seems like people have been
making wax sculptures for a long time.

In ancient times, death masks used to be
made from wax.

<CLT=cltMIND>A wax death mask...
That's kinda scary.

<CLT=cltMIND>A wax death mask...
That's kinda scary.
<CLT=cltMIND>I'll investigate around here a little more.

<CLT=cltMIND>This door...isn't the one we used
to come in.

This door is super crappy...
I'm guessing this is the rear entrance.

See? It's got a sliding lock just slapped 
on here.
Ah, right, and the door that we used...

Yeah, that door has a knob and
a cylinder lock.

The same classroom has two different kinds
of locks for the doors. That's mildly infuriating.
No, no. It's perfect that they're not the same.

Symmetry is a western beauty ideal. They like
symmetry and the golden ratio and such...

But I think asymmetry and partition functions
are more beautiful.

Well, I don't really get it, but...
I suppose that makes sense.

<CLT=cltMIND>This door...isn't the one we used
to come in.

<CLT=cltMIND>This door has a sliding lock.
The door that we used...

<CLT=cltMIND>Has a cylinder lock inside
the door knob.

The same classroom has two different kinds
of locks for the doors. That's mildly infuriating.

<CLT=cltMIND>I can't stay long. I still haven't found the
<CLT=cltSTRONG>Flashback Light<CLT=cltMIND>...
<CLT=cltMIND>I have other places to check.
